# Groovemark

> Last updated 2026-11-06. This file and the pages linked below are the only current description of Groovemark; any earlier pages under /services/ or /legal/ are retired and redirect here.

> Groovemark LLC (Missoula, Montana) builds and runs web sites for trade businesses anywhere in the United States: plumbers, electricians, roofers, HVAC, general contractors and construction, welders, body shops and other trades. $350 once to get the site live, then $350 a month to run it, billed from the day it is live. Free preview within 1 business day. Month to month, no contract, cancel with 30 days' notice. The owner is Jonathan; call or text 406-209-8235.

## What is included
- A web site written for the trade and the towns the business works in, built to work on a phone with tap to call
- Chat on the site that answers questions around the clock and takes the caller's name and number
- A Google review request texted to the customer after every job
- The Google Business Profile kept accurate, with every review answered in the owner's words

## How it goes
1. The owner texts his business name, town and trade to 406-209-8235. 2. Groovemark builds a free preview and texts back the link within 1 business day. 3. A 15-minute call to fix what the owner wants changed. 4. If the owner likes it, $350 when he says go, live within 7 business days; $350 a month starts the day the site is live and Groovemark keeps it running. Or the owner books a 15-minute call at least 1 day ahead at https://links.groovemarkhq.com/call; Groovemark builds the preview before the call and walks him through it on the call, by phone or Google Meet.

## Straight answers
- Do I own it? The owner's name, number and Google listing are theirs. The web site is Groovemark's while Groovemark runs it; a flat price to take it is quoted before the owner says go, not after.
- Do I need to be good with computers? No. No logins, no dashboard. Text photos; after each job, type the customer's name and number into a simple form.
- Is a Facebook page enough? Keep it, but Facebook is where friends see posts. Google is where a stranger looks a business up at night; if all he finds is a Facebook page, he calls the next business.
- What does the $350 a month cover? Hosting, the chat that answers at night, the review text after every job, the Google Business Profile kept accurate, and unlimited changes to photos, hours, services and company information.
- How soon will it bring calls? Not overnight. The site, the chat, the review requests and the Google listing compound: each job adds a review, each review improves the next search, the site turns searches into calls.
- Can you promise the top of Google? Groovemark gives Google every reason to rank the business: a real site, an accurate listing, more reviews.

## Also available, each month to month with no contract
- Voice Agents (https://groovemarkhq.com/voice-agents/): an AI phone agent that answers every call to the business in a natural voice, day or night, collects the caller's name, number, address and problem, texts the owner a summary, books jobs on the calendar and puts emergencies straight through. $530 one time to build, $350 a month to run, up to 500 minutes of calls a month included. Answering within 5 business days. Does not require the web site.
- Social Media Management (https://groovemarkhq.com/social-media/): the owner texts job photos to one number when they want to; none are required. Groovemark writes the posts (from photos when sent, otherwise from the business’s Google reviews, past work and trade know-how) and the same system that runs the web site chat schedules and publishes them, answers Facebook and Instagram messages around the clock, and emails monthly stats. $350 one-time setup, then three monthly packages: Intro $350 (Facebook and Instagram, 3 posts a week, messages answered, reviews as posts), Steady $710 (Facebook, Instagram and X (Twitter), 4 posts a week, comments answered weekdays, monthly stats), Growth $1,250 (everything in Steady plus TikTok, 5 posts a week, 6 short videos, boosted posts on Facebook and Instagram with ad spend separate, monthly call). Does not require the web site.

## About Groovemark (https://groovemarkhq.com/about/)
- Groovemark LLC is a one-person digital marketing agency in Missoula, Montana, founded April 2026 by Jonathan, who ran a retail bank branch for fifteen years working with trade business owners before starting it. Mission: give trade businesses the web site, phone answering and social media the big outfits have, built and run for them so the owner never has to become a computer guy.
- Works with trade businesses in all 50 U.S. states by text, phone and a 15-minute call; the owner never needs to be in Montana. Trades served: plumbing, electrical, roofing, HVAC, general contracting, remodeling, excavation, concrete, drain cleaning, septic, tree service, landscaping, painting, flooring, fencing, garage doors, welding and fabrication, auto body and repair, handyman, and other local service trades.
- How it works: prices published on the site, no contract on any service, month to month, see the web site preview or hear the phone agent before paying, one person answers the number, nothing held hostage if the client leaves.
